scripts.build:cjs: tsc --module commonjs --esModuleInterop --outDir dist/cjs --rootDir src src/hexMath.ts src/contracts/index.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['hexMath','contracts/index']){const p='dist/cjs/'+f+'.js';if(fs.existsSync(p)){const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');fs.writeFileSync('dist/'+f+'.cjs',s);}}fs.rmSync('dist/cjs',{recursive:true,force:true});"
